background_summary: I was selected in the lottery, but my employer mentioned they might file around June.
concerns_or_questions_summary: Has anyone’s employer started filing H-1B petitions for FY 2027? When are employers typically starting to file this year? How long does it usually take to prepare and submit the petition after selection? What is the total cost (regular vs premium processing)? If premium processing is used, how quickly can the petition be filed and approved?
